declared.change: add a zero-initialised 1x1 convolution on the coarse branch whose output is ADDED to the convex blend, so the head can place its prediction outside the [raw, aligned memory] interval
declared.honest_note: This relaxes the constraint, it does not remove it. A head that never uses the extrapolation term is evidence FOR convexity; one that does is evidence against.
declared.initialisation: zero, so training starts exactly at the canonical model and any departure from convexity is learned rather than imposed
declared.rationale: Minimal relaxation of the convexity constraint. Removing the sigmoid from fusion_weight instead would have been unfair: the loss supervises that weight as a probability and an unbounded weight makes those terms degenerate, so we would be ablating the loss and not the architecture.
